wired: New York Fed Markets Data API: SOFR and EFFR, last 30 published business days (two exact routes)
Treasury nominal par curve history (current and previous year feeds) for 5- and 20-entry moves and 10Y volatility
BLS release-calendar ICS, else the official monthly List View (current and next exchange session)
BLS Employment Situation and CPI values from their current-edition release pages, once the calendar's release time passes
BLS JOLTS and Productivity and Costs readers (disabled until explicitly enabled in config/economic_actuals.json)
Statistics Canada Labour Force Survey values from the dated Daily release (disabled until explicitly enabled)
NVIDIA official press-release RSS (exact feed URL): dated issuer releases, and the revenue and diluted EPS a results release reports
SLV silver ETF proxy via the existing Alpaca batch
deferred: direct SEC EDGAR filings (no SEC-specific contact configured)
policy: Only normalized records with explicit retention permission persist; only llm_allowed facts enter synthesis. Public government factual extracts are admitted with the source acknowledgement required by their terms. No account or credential discovery. Continuity carries structured prior state (watches, relationships, snapshots) for at most one exchange session between close and premarket; retention of run archives is thirty days in Actions artifacts.
